en.summary: The patch fixes a top-level bit-width bug so CTA kernel-dimension metadata can represent the maximum configured work-group count correctly.
why_it_counts: WG_SIZE_X/Y/Z_WIDTH are widened from log2Ceil(NUM_WG_*) to log2Ceil(NUM_WG_* + 1).
Those widths feed host_kernel_size_3d, which is forwarded into CTA scheduling as num_wg_x, num_wg_y, and num_wg_z.
Wrong widths can truncate maximum configured dimension values and misconfigure CTA launch parameters.
disqualifiers: The commit also fills a missing host_pds_size_per_wf field in the MemBox bundle literal.
evidence: parameters.scala changes all three dimension widths to include +1.
MemBox.scala builds host_kernel_size_3d using those widths when generating metadata.
The host-side bundle in GPGPU_top.scala already expects NUM_WG_DIM_MAX+1-sized kernel dimension fields.

fault_injection_plan.suggested_edit: Change WG_SIZE_X_WIDTH, WG_SIZE_Y_WIDTH, and WG_SIZE_Z_WIDTH back to log2Ceil(NUM_WG_X), log2Ceil(NUM_WG_Y), and log2Ceil(NUM_WG_Z).
fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: Maximum grid dimensions wrap or truncate, so too few work-groups are dispatched.
notes: The host_pds_size_per_wf literal addition is incidental to this bug.
fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: Launch metadata carries work-group counts, not zero-based indices. If those count fields are sized for 0..N-1 while the architecture allows N itself, the maximum legal launch count truncates at the host-to-scheduler boundary.

portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: A kernel launch uses the maximum supported work-group count in one or more dimensions.
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: Size grid-count fields for max index instead of max count.
portability_notes: Apply to any dispatch path where software provides counts to hardware scheduling logic.
concrete_injection_steps: Find the packed launch fields carrying grid counts.
Reduce their widths from log2Ceil(max+1) to log2Ceil(max).
Launch at the configured maximum grid size and observe truncation.

repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: The fix widens WG_SIZE_X/Y/Z_WIDTH from log2Ceil(NUM_WG_*) to log2Ceil(NUM_WG_* + 1).
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: Restore WG_SIZE_X/Y/Z_WIDTH to log2Ceil(NUM_WG_*); MemBox then repacks host_kernel_size_3d with the too-small widths.

evidence_for_injection: GPGPU_top expects the corrected +1 sizing convention.

zh.summary: 该补丁修复了顶层位宽错误，使 CTA kernel 维度元数据能够正确表示配置允许的最大 work-group 数量。
why_it_counts: WG_SIZE_X/Y/Z_WIDTH 从 log2Ceil(NUM_WG_*) 扩展为 log2Ceil(NUM_WG_* + 1)。
这些位宽用于 host_kernel_size_3d，并进一步作为 num_wg_x、num_wg_y、num_wg_z 送入 CTA 调度逻辑。
原位宽会截断最大维度值，从而错误配置 CTA 启动参数。
disqualifiers: 该提交还顺带补上了 MemBox bundle literal 中缺失的 host_pds_size_per_wf 字段。
evidence: parameters.scala 将三个维度位宽都修改为包含 +1。
MemBox.scala 在生成元数据时使用这些位宽构造 host_kernel_size_3d。
GPGPU_top.scala 中的 host 侧 bundle 本就按 NUM_WG_DIM_MAX+1 的语义定义 kernel 维度字段。

fault_injection_plan.target_module_or_logic: host2CTA 的 kernel 维度位宽参数
fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: 最大 grid 维度会回绕或截断，导致派发的 work-group 数量不足。
notes: host_pds_size_per_wf 的 literal 补充与核心 bug 无关。
fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: launch 元数据携带的是 work-group 数量，而不是从零开始的索引。如果这些计数字段只按 0..N-1 定宽，而体系结构允许数量值本身达到 N，那么最大合法 launch 数量就会在 host 到调度器的边界上被截断。

portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: kernel launch 在某个维度上使用了最大支持的 work-group 数量。
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: 把 grid 计数字段按最大索引而不是最大计数来定宽。
portability_notes: 可映射到任何由软件把“数量”送给硬件调度逻辑的分发路径。
concrete_injection_steps: 找到打包 launch grid 数量的字段。
把其位宽从 log2Ceil(max+1) 缩到 log2Ceil(max)。
用最大 grid size 启动并观察数量被截断。

evidence_for_injection: 这些位宽直接喂给 host_kernel_size_3d。
